data.title: 五更琉璃 · 满月天台夜魔黑羽折扇的命运咏叹
data.description: 夜幕降临的住宅楼天台，黑猫身着华丽繁复的“夜魔女王”暗黑哥特萝莉塔盛装，手执黑羽折扇半遮娇颜，迎着巨大圆月展开中二的深渊独白。
data.location: 城市公寓楼顶夜景天台
data.action: 以黑羽折扇半掩下半张脸，血红瞳孔（美瞳）凝视满月，黑色蕾丝荷叶裙摆在夜风中猎猎作响
data.lighting: 巨大银白满月的光芒与城市霓虹地光勾勒剪影，神秘暗黑
data.camera: 仰角中景构图，尽显哥特美学的精致与庄重
data.promptProse: Kuroneko adopts a grandiose theatrical stance on the breezy rooftop of a residential apartment complex under the luminescent face of a giant full moon. Draped in her elaborate 'Queen of Nightmare' gothic lolita ensemble with layered black lace ruffles and a corseted velvet bodice, she holds an ebony feather folding fan across her lips. Her crimson-tinted lenses gleam with arcane pride against the city lights.
data.animaCaption: Veiling her lower face with a black feather fan, Kuroneko strikes a dramatic gothic pose beneath the colossal full moon.
